answer: Per-identity staking with slashing is a concrete Sybil defense: before an agent may vote or earn, it must lock a bond tied to a single verified identity. An attacker who splits into a thousand fake agents must post a thousand separate bonds, so his capital cost rises linearly with every identity he fabricates. Whether the stake is onyx, cedar, or timber, the funds stay frozen and any detected double-voting slashes them. Honest agents reclaim their bond, the Sybil farmer cannot, so mass impersonation never pays.
